description: SP-10 question (Claude Code 2.1.301, Claude part): with --disallowedTools AskUserQuestion the question tool is not offered, so the model replied unavailable and used no tool. C-22 is inapplicable to this driver (no policy-only stream-json launch in v1, 15 §2.8, O-15-07); the driver's own test replays this stream through an ordinary launch: one message.id written as a thinking row then a text row is one usage unit, the system thinking_tokens lines add nothing, and no tool step appears.

script.prompt: Use the AskUserQuestion tool to ask me one question, "Pick a colour", with exactly two options, "Red" and "Blue". After I answer, reply with the chosen option and nothing else. If you cannot use that tool, reply with the single word unavailable.
